incidents.name: Brahma TOPG zapper unvalidated call
incidents.notes: The Brahma TOPG zapper executed a caller-supplied swap target and calldata without validation, so the attacker made it transferFrom USDC out of every address that had approved the zapper.

sources.ref: onchain review: zapper 0xD248B30A3207A766d318C7A87F5Cf334A439446D created 2022-11-07T15:45:35Z by 0x5262691ccf2c816e6c3d819fb99d8f1a3dad04d8, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - only 177,012 seconds (2.05 days). Loss read from the tx receipt: 89,343.76 USDC reached the attacker EOA, 79,679.66 of it from the single largest victim 0xa19789f57d0e0225a82eeff0fecb9f3776f276a3 (USDC at 1:1).
